summary.text: Artie Mingo (listed on Ballotpedia as Arthur Mingo) is a Republican state representative who has represented Maine House District 9 since December 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is self-employed and a former mayor of Calais.

paragraphs.text: Mingo's career experience includes serving as the CEO of Mingo Products and as a volunteer firefighter.
He previously served as the mayor of Calais for two years and as a city councilor for 18 years.
Mingo assumed office in the Maine House on December 3, 2024, succeeding Anne Perry, and advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.
